Split text on any whitespace and return its words in reverse order joined by single spaces. Empty or whitespace-only input returns an empty string.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "  red\tgreen blue  "
  ],
  "expected": "blue green red"
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    ""
  ],
  "expected": ""
}
Hint

Use split without a separator to normalize whitespace.

Complexity: O(n) time and space
